title: Completed stalk comparisons and source reparametrization
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n$. Let $Z\xrightarrow{h}Y\xrightarrow{f}X$ be morphisms of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible, with small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Use the derived-complete integral constructible categories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], their raw rationalizations [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], and the completed pullbacks of [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Specify their composition comparisons by [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization]. For $\Lambda=\mathcal O_E$ or $E$, any one of these schemes $T$, a geometric point $v:s\to T$ [def-weil-geometric-point], and $M\in D^b_c(T,\Lambda)$, put $J_v(M)=\operatorname{Fib}_{s,\Lambda}(Lv^*M)$, with [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. In the comparison for $f$ below take $v:s\to Y$ and $M\in D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$; in the reparametrization comparison take $M$ on the target of $v$.

There are natural $\Lambda$-linear comparison isomorphisms
$$c_{f,v,M}:J_v(Lf^*M)\xrightarrow{\sim}J_{fv}(M),\qquad r_{v,\alpha,M}:J_v(M)\xrightarrow{\sim}J_{v\delta}(M),\quad\delta=\operatorname{Spec}(\alpha),\quad\alpha\in\operatorname{Aut}(k).$$
Here $c$ uses the specified pullback-composition comparison, and $r$ is normalized by the finite-level germ rule $[U,u,a]\mapsto[U,u\delta,a]$ in [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk]. Their integral constructions realize these comparisons as maps of the simultaneous strict reduction diagrams, using the comparisons of [lem-trf-proetale-pullback-stalk-coherence]; their rational constructions are their images under rationalization. In particular, the asserted equalities are equalities of those specified maps, not merely equality of their individual reductions.

For $w:s\to Z$, write $\chi_{h,f}:L(fh)^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh^*Lf^*$. Then
$$c_{fh,w,M}=c_{f,hw,M}\circ c_{h,w,Lf^*M}\circ J_w(\chi_{h,f,M}),\qquad c_{\mathrm{id},v,M}=1,$$
$$r_{fv,\alpha,M}\circ c_{f,v,M}=c_{f,v\delta,M}\circ r_{v,\alpha,Lf^*M}.$$
If $\epsilon=\operatorname{Spec}(\beta)$, then $r_{v\delta,\beta,M}\circ r_{v,\alpha,M}=r_{v,\beta\circ\alpha,M}$, and $r_{v,1,M}=1$; equivalently the composite reparametrizes by $\delta\circ\epsilon$. All these comparisons are natural in arbitrary morphisms of the specified integral or rational categories.

For $N\in D^b_c(s,\Lambda)$ and any such $\delta$, let $j_{\delta,N}:\operatorname{Fib}_sN\to\operatorname{Fib}_sL\delta^*N$ be restriction of sections along $\delta$, followed by inverse-image colimit insertion and the inverse-image/pullback comparison of [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison] (and rationalization for $E$). Under the identity-point identification $J_{\mathrm{id}}(N)=\operatorname{Fib}_sN$, one has
$$c_{\delta,\mathrm{id},N}\circ j_{\delta,N}=r_{\mathrm{id},\alpha,N}.$$
This last equation is compatible with any finite succession of source automorphisms and with the comparisons for $v:s\to X$. No Weil structure, periodic point, or endomorphism of $M$ is assumed.
